deep_dive.title: From Depth to Safe Depth: Uncertainty-Aware Monocular Perception for Mobile Robot Navigation
deep_dive.abstract: Monocular depth foundation models make it tempting to replace depth sensors on mobile robots with a single RGB camera. We show that, used off the shelf, this is unsafe: in a simulated indoor navigation benchmark, a standard Nav2 stack driven by Depth Anything V2 (metric) collides in 63\% of 120 episodes, because the model systematically over-estimates the distance to nearby obstacles. We propose a lightweight plug-in module that turns predicted depth into \emph{safe depth}. A 0.58\,M-parameter head on top of the \emph{frozen} depth model predicts, per pixel, a log-depth correction $μ$ and an uncertainty $σ$, trained with a $β$-weighted Gaussian negative log-likelihood. The navigation stack consumes the one-sided bound $\hat d_{\text{safe}}=d\,e^{μ-kσ}$, where $k$ is set by conformal calibration on a held-out world, and uncertainty also decides which pixels may be treated as floor. The correction halves the depth error (AbsRel $0.262\rightarrow0.134$) and reduces near-range over-estimation from 59.8\% to 12.0\%. In navigation, safe depth raises the success rate from 37\% to 70\% and lowers collisions from 63\% to 3\%, close to the 2\% of ground-truth depth. A constant safety margin calibrated to the same pixel coverage reaches only 30\% success because it freezes the robot; uncertainty-aware safety wins 52 of 56 discordant paired episodes against it. Gains hold on glass, texture-less walls and dark regions.
deep_dive.llm_evidence_en: Uses frozen Depth Anything V2 metric depth with a lightweight 0.58M head for safe monocular depth
deep_dive.llm_evidence_cn: 在冻结的Depth Anything V2度量深度上接轻量0.58M参数头输出安全深度

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Off-the-shelf Depth Anything V2 over-estimates near-obstacle distance, causing 63% collisions in robot navigation; a 0.58M-param uncertainty-aware head corrects predicted depth into safe depth and greatly reduces collisions.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 论文指出直接用单目深度基础模型替代深度传感器并不安全，Depth Anything V2 会系统性高估近处障碍距离，导致导航碰撞。作者提出一个仅0.58M参数的轻量插件模块，在冻结的深度模型上逐像素预测对数深度修正与不确定性，并以β加权高斯负对数似然训练，输出单侧安全深度界。在仿真室内导航基准中原始模型碰撞率高达63%，校正后显著下降，说明轻量不确定性校正能让单目深度模型安全落地于移动机器人。
